<header class="c-pagehead">
  <div class="c-wrap">
<h1>Training programmes</h1>
    <p>
      Four programmes, one for each research group. Each is the entry
      requirement for its group: a student completes the relevant programme
      first, then joins a project. They exist because nothing equivalent is
      freely available to most undergraduates here.
    </p>
  </div>
</header>

<section class="c-slab c-slab--paper">
  <div class="c-wrap">
    <div class="c-slab-head">
      <span class="c-eyebrow">Entry requirements</span>
      <h2 class="c-h2">One programme per group</h2>
      <p class="c-lede">
        Apply to the group whose questions interest you, and take its
        programme. Each one ends where the group's real work begins — a
        student who finishes it can be handed a dataset and a supervisor rather
        than a tutorial.
      </p>
    </div>

```{=html}
    <div class="c-mini" style="margin-top:2.5rem">
      <p>
        <strong>Open course materials.</strong> Much of what these programmes
        teach is already online and free to work through before you apply:
        <a href="https://omicscenter.github.io/BioinformaticsBootCamp/">Bioinformatics Bootcamp</a>,
        <a href="https://omicscenter.github.io/RforBioinformatics/">R for Bioinformatics</a>,
        <a href="https://omicscenter.github.io/RNASeqwithR/">RNA-seq analysis with R</a> and
        <a href="https://omicscenter.github.io/scRNASeqwithR/">single-cell RNA-seq with R</a>.
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="c-btn-row" style="margin-top:2.5rem">
      <a class="c-btn c-btn--dark" href="mailto:chiralbd@gmail.com?subject=Application%20for%20a%20training%20programme">Apply to a programme</a>
      <a class="c-btn c-btn--line" href="../events/">Upcoming dates</a>
      <a class="c-btn c-btn--line" href="../resources/">Self-study resources</a>
    </div>
  </div>

<section class="c-slab c-slab--white">
  <div class="c-wrap">
    <div class="c-split">
      <div class="c-prose">
        <h2>How the programmes run</h2>
        <p>
          Sessions are hands-on and mostly online, so students outside Dhaka can
          take part. Every session ends with an exercise on real data, and the
          material stays available afterwards.
        </p>
        <p>
          Training is free. It is also not a certificate mill — the programmes are
          assessed on whether a participant can go on to do the analysis unaided,
          because that is what joining a group actually asks of them.
        </p>

        <h2>Who these are for</h2>
        <p>
          University students in life sciences, computer science, medicine, public
          health, statistics, geography and related fields. No programming
          background is assumed — each programme starts from the command line or
          the language it needs, and builds from there.
        </p>
        <p>
          Take the programme for the group you want to join. Nothing stops a
          student taking a second one later, and several of our researchers have,
          but one is what is required to start.
        </p>

        <h2>Teaching materials</h2>
        <p>
          Course notebooks and slides are openly licensed and remain online after
          each cohort. See <a href="../resources/">learning resources</a> for the
          databases and tools we teach against, and
          <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@hossainlab">recorded sessions</a> where
          available.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="c-aside">
        <dl class="c-facts">
          <dt>Cost</dt>
          <dd>Free. The centre charges nothing for training.</dd>

          <dt>Format</dt>
          <dd>Hands-on, primarily online, with materials retained after the cohort.</dd>

          <dt>Prerequisites</dt>
          <dd>None. Each programme starts from the beginning.</dd>

          <dt>Required for</dt>
          <dd>Joining a research group. One programme, matched to the group you apply to.</dd>

          <dt>Next cohort</dt>
          <dd><span class="c-todo">To be announced</span></dd>

          <dt>Enquiries</dt>
          <dd><a href="mailto:chiralbd@gmail.com">chiralbd@gmail.com</a></dd>
        </dl>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```
